task_requests.description: Define the peer set and normalize metrics for the comps workflow: identify comparable companies, standardize operating and financial metrics across the peer group for consistent comparison.
Compare valuation multiples across the peer set and explain why outliers deserve a premium or discount: analyze relative valuation, identify outliers, and justify premium or discount positioning.

args.data:
Coordinator Note: Finance Comps Workflow

Two workstreams have been delegated to support the comparable companies analysis:

1. peers-analyst — Define the peer set and normalize metrics: identify comparable companies and standardize operating and financial metrics across the peer group for consistent comparison.

2. multiples-analyst — Compare valuation multiples and explain outliers: analyze relative valuation across the peer set, identify outliers, and justify why they deserve a premium or discount.

These workstreams together cover the full comps workflow: define the peer set, normalize metrics, compare valuation multiples, and explain why outliers deserve premium or discount.
